business_model.basis: stated in S0, P3, and P5
business_model.claim: Youdao, Inc. operates in China's intelligent learning industry as an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising.
quotes: Youdao, Inc. (“Youdao” or the “Company”) (NYSE: DAO), an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising, today announced its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
We operate in China’s intelligent learning industry, and our financial condition and results of operations are influenced by a number of macroeconomic factors affecting this industry.

business_model.claim: Youdao reports revenue across three segments—learning services, smart devices, and online marketing services—generating total net revenues of ¥ 5,909,019 ($ 844,979) (table in thousands) in 2025, up from ¥ 5,625,919 in 2024 and ¥ 5,389,208 in 2023.
quotes: We have three reportable segments: (i) learning services, (ii) smart devices, and (iii) online marketing services.

business_model.claim: Learning services, the largest segment at 2,630,571 in RMB and 376,167 in US$ (table in thousands) in 2025, generates the majority of its revenue from tutoring services consisting of digital learning contents and online courses, including STEAM courses and adult courses.
quotes: We generate the majority of the net revenues of learning services from our tutoring services.
After we disposed of the Academic AST Business, we shifted our focus to tutoring services strategically centered on digital learning contents and STEAM courses.

business_model.claim: Beyond tutoring, learning services sells fee-based premium services, including AI-driven subscription packages for users of apps such as Youdao Dictionary and technology licensing through Youdao Smart Cloud to business customers.
quotes: In addition to tutoring services, we also generate net revenues from other learning services which are primarily fee-based premium services.

These services mainly include: (a) sales of subscription packages to users of our AI-driven subscription services, such as Youdao Dictionary, that allow them to access additional functions, content and privileges and (b) the licensing of technologies and solutions, including through Youdao Smart Cloud, to business customers.

business_model.claim: Tuition fees and digital learning content proceeds are collected in advance as deferred revenue—leaving RMB593.0 million (US$84.8 million) in tutoring deferred revenue as of December 31, 2025—with digital content recognized upon delivery and online courses recognized ratably over an estimated weighted average learning period of five months.
quotes: The estimated weighted average duration of learning periods of our online courses was five months for the periods presented in this annual report.
As of December 31, 2024 and 2025, we had deferred revenue of RMB638.3 million and RMB593.0 million (US$84.8 million), respectively, from our tutoring services.

business_model.claim: Smart devices sells intelligent learning hardware—mainly Youdao Dictionary Pen and Youdao Tutoring Pen, alongside Youdao Smart Learning Terminal—through retailers or distributors, generating RMB739.6 million (US$105.8 million), or 12.5%, of total net revenues in 2025, down from RMB903.7 million (16.1%) in 2024 and RMB909.2 million (16.9%) in 2023.
quotes: We sell smart devices such as Youdao Dictionary Pen and Youdao Tutoring Pen to customers through retailers or distributors.

In 2023, 2024 and 2025, our net revenues generated from smart devices were RMB909.2 million, RMB903.7 million and RMB739.6 million (US$105.8 million), representing approximately 16.9%, 16.1% and 12.5%, respectively, of our total net revenues.

business_model.claim: Online marketing services sells advertising in formats such as banners, text links, videos, logos, buttons, and rich media—mainly via per-click performance-based ads and fixed-fee global promotion—growing from RMB1,331.9 million (24.7% of total net revenues) in 2023 to RMB2,538.8 million (US$363.0 million) (43.0%) in 2025.
quotes: We primarily offer performance-based advertising solutions which mainly charged on a per-click basis, as well as global marketing and promotion services, which typically charged as fixed advertising fees.

In 2023, 2024 and 2025, our net revenues generated from online marketing services were RMB1,331.9 million, RMB1,975.0 million and RMB2,538.8 million (US$363.0 million), representing approximately 24.7%, 35.1% and 43.0%, respectively, of our total net revenues.

business_model.basis: stated in F2, P3, and P5
business_model.claim: Online marketing growth in 2025 was driven by demand from the NetEase group and overseas markets alongside AI technology investments, with related-party net revenues rising from RMB182,586 in 2024 to RMB920,917 in 2025 (tables in thousands), though online marketing revenue declined 7.7% year-over-year in the second quarter of 2026 while learning services rose 20.9%.
quotes: The year over year increase in 2025 was driven by the increased demand for the NetEase group and overseas markets, which was further driven by our continued investments in AI technology.
Net revenues from online marketing services were RMB584.4 million (US$86.1 million), representing a 7.7% decrease from the same period in 2025.

business_model.claim: Overall gross margin fell from 51.4% in 2023 to 48.9% in 2024 and 44.3% in 2025 as lower-margin online marketing services—whose gross margin was 27.1% in 2025 versus 60.2% for learning services and 46.4% for smart devices—expanded to 56.2 (table % of total cost of revenues column) of total cost of revenues.
quotes: In 2023, 2024 and 2025, our overall gross margin was 51.4%, 48.9% and 44.3%, respectively.

During the same periods, the gross margin of learning services was 63.2%, 61.4% and 60.2%, respectively, the gross margin of smart devices was 39.2%, 38.7% and 46.4%, respectively, and the gross margin of online marketing services was 31.7%, 36.0% and 27.1%, respectively.

business_model.claim: Direct cost drivers vary by segment: teaching staff salaries, instructor revenue sharing, payment channel fees, course materials, and technical support in learning services; hardware unit and operations staff costs in smart devices; and third-party traffic acquisition payments and operations payroll in online marketing.
quotes: Our cost of revenues of smart devices consists primarily of (i) costs relating to the sales of our smart devices and (ii) costs associated with our operation staff related to smart devices.

Our cost of revenues of online marketing services consists primarily of (i) traffic acquisition costs, which consist primarily of payments to third parties that distribute our advertisers’ advertisements through such third parties’ internet properties; and (ii) payroll-related expenses, which consist primarily of the salaries and other benefits paid to our operation personnel that support our online marketing services.

business_model.claim: Operating expenses are dominated by sales and marketing—comprising online traffic acquisition, branding, sales payroll, and outsourced providers—at 70.3 (table % of total operating expenses column) in 2025, while total operating expenses declined from 60.1 (table % of total net revenues column) in 2023 to 40.6 in 2025 alongside lower R&D spending as a share of revenue.
quotes: We expect to further enhance the efficiency of our sales and marketing expenses to decrease its percentage of revenue over time in the long run.
We expect to increase the investment in the use of leading technologies such as AI, aiming to lower our research and development related labor costs by leveraging these advanced technologies.

business_model.claim: To comply with PRC foreign-ownership restrictions on value-added telecommunications and 2021 tutoring regulations, Youdao disposed of its Academic AST Business in 2021 and conducts a large portion of its operations through consolidated VIEs, which generated 3,939,199 (table in RMB thousands) of third-party net revenues in 2025.
quotes: We ceased to offer the Academic AST Business in the fourth quarter of 2021, in order to fully comply with applicable PRC regulatory requirements adopted by the PRC government in the second half of 2021.

business_model.claim: NetEase Group provides business cooperation and financing support, including a US$300.0 million revolving loan facility extended to March 31, 2030 with approximately US$132.1 million (RMB926.6 million) drawn at December 31, 2025, and related-party interest expense of RMB62,972 (table in thousands) in 2025.
quotes: Historically, the Group has relied principally on both operational sources of cash and non-operational sources of financing from NetEase Group and investors to fund its operations and business development.

In September 2023, the Group renewed the US$300.0 million revolving loan facility (the “Facility”) agreement initially signed with NetEase in April 2021, extending the maturity date from March 31, 2024 to March 31, 2027.

competitive_position.claim: Youdao launched its flagship Youdao Dictionary in 2007 and describes it as China's leading language app.
quotes: In 2007, we launched our flagship Youdao Dictionary, China’s leading language app.

competitive_position.claim: Youdao states that Confucius, launched in 2023, was China's first LLM specifically for the education sector, and in 2025 it embedded Confucius across learning services, online marketing services, and smart devices.
quotes: For example, we launched our large language model (LLM), Confucius, in 2023, which is China’s first LLM specifically for education sector.

In 2025, we advanced our AI-native strategy by expanding our Confucius LLM portfolio and embedding it across our learning services, online marketing services and smart devices, launching new AI offerings such as Scholar AI, the AI Ad Placement Optimizer and Youdao iMagicBox, and expanding our smart device portfolio with the launch of brand-new tutoring pens Youdao SpaceOne and Youdao Space X.

competitive_position.claim: Online marketing services net revenues increased from RMB1,331.9 million (24.7% of total net revenues) in 2023 to RMB2,538.8 million (43.0%) in 2025, while tutoring services declined from RMB2,914.1 million (54.1%) to RMB2,086.3 million (35.3%).
quotes: In 2023, 2024 and 2025, our net revenues generated from online marketing services were RMB1,331.9 million, RMB1,975.0 million and RMB2,538.8 million (US$363.0 million), representing approximately 24.7%, 35.1% and 43.0%, respectively, of our total net revenues.

In 2023, 2024 and 2025, our net revenues generated from tutoring services were RMB2,914.1 million, RMB2,384.7 million and RMB2,086.3 million (US$298.3 million), representing approximately 54.1%, 42.4% and 35.3%, respectively, of our total net revenues.

competitive_position.claim: In 2025, learning services had a 60.2% gross margin and smart devices reached a 46.4% gross margin, whereas online marketing services had a 27.1% gross margin and overall gross margin fell from 51.4% in 2023 to 44.3% in 2025.
quotes: In 2023, 2024 and 2025, our overall gross margin was 51.4%, 48.9% and 44.3%, respectively.

During the same periods, the gross margin of learning services was 63.2%, 61.4% and 60.2%, respectively, the gross margin of smart devices was 39.2%, 38.7% and 46.4%, respectively, and the gross margin of online marketing services was 31.7%, 36.0% and 27.1%, respectively.

competitive_position.claim: Sales and marketing expenses declined from 42.2 of total net revenues in 2023 to 28.6 in 2025, and research and development expenses declined from 13.8 to 8.7 over the same period (table in percentages).

In the second quarter of 2026, total net revenues rose 3.5% year over year to RMB1.5 billion and gross margin expanded to 48.9% from 43.0%, as a 20.9% increase in learning services to RMB795.6 million offset declines in online marketing services (7.7%) and smart devices (31.5%).

Net revenues from learning services were RMB795.6 million (US$117.3 million), representing a 20.9% increase from the same period in 2025.

competitive_position.claim: Management describes Youdao as a leader in intelligent learning smart devices, yet smart devices net revenues declined from RMB909.2 million in 2023 to RMB739.6 million in 2025 and fell 31.5% year over year to RMB86.8 million in the second quarter of 2026.
quotes: As a leader in intelligent learning, we have invested significantly in our smart devices to stay at the forefront of technology.

In 2023, 2024 and 2025, our net revenues generated from smart devices were RMB909.2 million, RMB903.7 million and RMB739.6 million (US$105.8 million), representing approximately 16.9%, 16.1% and 12.5%, respectively, of our total net revenues.
Net revenues from smart devices were RMB86.8 million (US$12.8 million), representing a 31.5% decrease from the same period in 2025.

competitive_position.claim: Rapid technological change in AI and intelligent learning poses a competitive threat that new technologies or solutions from competitors could render Youdao's offerings less attractive or obsolete.
quotes: New technologies and solutions developed and introduced by our competitors could render our offerings less attractive or obsolete thus materially affecting our business and prospects.

If we fail to continue to develop, innovate and utilize our technologies or if our competitors develop or apply more advanced technologies, our business, financial condition and results of operations could be materially and adversely affected.

competitive_position.claim: New 2025 offerings such as Youdao Dictionary Pen X7 Pro and Youdao Space X have limited operating histories and have not generated significant revenues, while broadening monetization requires staying ahead of competitors in product quality and marketing efficiency.
quotes: These new product and service offerings are still in their initial stages of development and have not generated significant revenues and there is no guarantee that they may become key growth drivers of our company in the future.

Specifically, in order to increase the number of our users and their levels of engagement and spending, we will need to address a number of challenges, including providing consistently high-quality and effective learning content, products and services; continuing to innovate and stay ahead of our competitors; and improving the effectiveness and efficiency of our sales and marketing efforts.

competitive_position.claim: PRC regulatory changes, including the 2021 Alleviating Burden Opinion that led Youdao to dispose of its Academic AST Business (approximately 25.0% of 2021 net revenues), and evolving AI laws create ongoing compliance, cost, and potential infringement risks.

Our compliance with the Opinions on Further Alleviating the Burden of Homework and After-School Tutoring for Students in Compulsory Education and the implementation measures issued by the relevant PRC government authorities has materially and adversely affected and may continue to affect our and the VIEs’ business, financial condition, results of operations and prospect.

competitive_position.claim: Youdao faces operational risk from potential interruptions or disputes at its smart device suppliers and from any failure to maintain recognition of the Youdao brand.

Our business depends on the continued success of our brand, and if we fail to maintain and enhance recognition of our brand, our reputation and operating results may be harmed

competitive_position.claim: Operations rely on contractual arrangements with VIEs in China and face risks of PRC government intervention, VIE contract enforceability, restrictions on offshore funding transfers, and potential U.S. trading prohibition under the HFCAA.
